title: 2026 GCF HGV SCR and urea-emissions QA

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors for company reporting: Methodology paper

facts.source_fact: HGV factors include emissions from urea consumption used for NOx control in SCR systems.
The HGV urea adjustment is included in overall CO2 emission factors.
The HGV SCR method follows the same urea-emissions method used for buses.
The bus SCR method treats urea solution as an exhaust-aftertreatment input rather than vehicle fuel.
SCR converts NOx into nitrogen and water vapour while producing a small amount of CO2.
Urea-related CO2 is therefore additional to fuel-combustion CO2 in the overall factor.
HGV CH4 and N2O factors are separately represented from the SCR-related CO2 adjustment.
HGV CH4 and N2O factors remain based on older inventory factors updated to AR5 GWP values.
The SCR adjustment belongs to vehicle-class conversion-factor methodology, not a parcel measurement.
Any automated calculation must keep the SCR methodology tied to HGV direct-emissions factors.
